Name: Custom Monsters
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[size=5][b]Creating Monster Types[/b][/size]

This mod lets you use Content Patcher to create new monster types based on existing vanilla types.

The sorts of things you can specify are:

[list]
[*]Basic characteristics like health, level, color, damage to farmer, experience gained on killing, etc.[/*]
[*]Monster and projectile sprites[/*]
[*]Sounds while moving, taking damage, dying, firing projectiles, etc.[/*]
[*]Projectile properties like damage and debuffs[/*]
[*]Class specific characteristics like number of serpent segments, whether spikers are vulnerable to damage, etc.[/*]
[/list]GreenSlime-based monsters can be bred with other monsters of their own type.

You can also specify whether a monster type should spawn instead of vanilla monsters on certain mine and volcano floors.


As an example:

[code]{
    "Format": "2.9.0",
    "Changes": [
        {
            "LogName": "Custom Monster Dictionary",
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.CustomMonsters/dict",
            "Entries": {
                "MyCustomMonster": {
                    "Type": "DinoMonster",
                    "Parameters": "position",
                    "MoveSound": "squid_hit",
                    "ProjectileSound": "yoba",
                    "Sprite": "{{ModId}}/CustomDino",
                    "ProjectileSprite": "{{ModId}}/CustomFire",
                    "Drops": [
                        {
                            "ItemId": "(O)74",
                            "MinQuantity": 1,
                            "MaxQuantity": 4,
                            "Chance": 10
                        }
                    ],
                    "MineSpawns": [
                        {
                            "MinLevel": 100,
                            "MaxLevel": 120,
                            "Chance": 10,
                            "Types": [
                                "BigSlime"
                            ]
                        }
                    ],
                    "LocationSpawns": [
                        {
                            "Location": "Town",
                            "MinSpawn": 1,
                            "MaxSpawn": 4,
                            "MaxAmount": 10,
                            "MinTile": {
                                "X": 52,
                                "Y": 24
                            },
                            "MaxTile": {
                                "X": 68,
                                "Y": 32
                            },
                            "Respawn": "Daily"
                        }
                    ]
                }
            }
        },
        {
            "LogName": "Custom Monster Texture Load",
            "Action": "Load",
            "Target": "{{ModId}}/CustomDino,{{ModId}}/CustomFire",
            "FromFile": "assets/{{TargetWithoutPath}}.png"
        },
        {
            "LogName": "Monster Spawn Test",
            "Action": "EditMap",
            "Target": "Maps/Town",
            "MapTiles": [
                {
                    "Position": {
                        "X": 28,
                        "Y": 67
                    },
                    "Layer": "Back",
                    "SetProperties": {
                        "DMT/monster_On": "MyCustomMonster 1792 4288"
                    }
                }
            ]
        }
    ]
}[/code]

The above adds a new monster type MyCustomMonster based on the DinoMonster type, giving it a new sprite, new projectile sprite, new move sound, new projectile sound, and new drops on death. 

It causes 1-4 monsters to spawn in the town near the community center.

It also gives it a chance to spawn instead of BigSlime monsters on floors 100-120.

[url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/blob/master/CustomMonsters/doc/doc.md]Full documentation on possible dictionary fields is here.[/url]


[size=5][b]Spawning Monsters[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Custom Locations[/b][/size]

Monsters can be spawned as above in a specific location, daily, hourly, or every ten mintues. MaxAmount limits the number of a given monster that can be spawned in a location.

See the [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/blob/master/CustomMonsters/doc/doc.md]full documentation[/url] for more info.


[b][size=4]Mines and Volcano[/size][/b]

Monsters can be made to spawn instead of vanilla monsters by specifying MineSpawns (as above) and/or VolcanoSpawns.

[list]
[*]MinLevel and MaxLevel refer to mine and volcano levels.[/*]
[*]Chance is the percent chance to replace a vanilla monster.[/*]
[*]Types is an optional list of monster types to replace with this type of monster. If omitted any monster type can be replaced.[/*]
[/list]See the [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/blob/master/CustomMonsters/doc/doc.md]full documentation[/url] for more info.


[b][size=4]Advanced Spawning[/size][/b]

The above example also includes a reference to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33900]Dynamic Map Tiles Extended[/url], which provides a means of spawning monsters in various ways using map properties. The above example spawns a monster when stepping on a specific tile.

C# Modders can use this mod's API to spawn defined custom monsters by accessing the mod's API, e.g.:

[code]var cmapi = SHelper.ModRegistry.GetApi<ICustomMonstersAPI>("aedenthorn.CustomMonsters");

if (cmapi != null)
{
    var monster = cmapi.CreateMonster("MyMonsterType", new Vector2(640, 320));
    if (monster != null)
    {
        Game1.currentLocation.characters.Add(monster);
    }
}[/code]

ICustomMonstersAPI should mirror the interface in [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/blob/master/CustomMonsters/CustomMonstersAPI.cs]this file[/url].


[b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
